title: Wade Wilson: Deadpool #10
desc:
ROAD TRIP!

DEADPOOL and BLIND AL take MERC MOBILE on the road! No job too big (well, maybe if it's, like, too difficult or annoying) and no job too small (I mean, as long as the money is huge), Merc Mobile will shoot/save whomever you want!

Even if that puts them at risk of GIANT GATORS in the EVERGLADES to save a millionaire's son! But is Blind Al's prediction on point?
